title: ieee80211: add ID ANSI support to VS SGDSN type 1 message
description:
Add support for the "ID ANSI" TLV (type 3) in SGDSN's vendor-specific tag dissector.

This TLV type contains Small Unmanned Aerial System serial number, formatted according to the ANSI/CTA2063 standard, as specified in the [french technical specification document](https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/eli/arrete/2019/12/27/ECOI1934044A/jo/texte) published on Légifrance.

The aforementioned standard is available for free on [https://shop.cta.tech/products/small-unmanned-aerial-systems-serial-numbers](https://shop.cta.tech/products/small-unmanned-aerial-systems-serial-numbers).

The Small Unmanned Aerial System serial number is formatted in accordance with the following ABNF:
```
ansi-cta2063-sn = icao-mfr-code mfr-serial-len-code mfr-serial
icao-mfr-code       = 4RALPHA
mfr-serial-len-code = RHEX
mfr-serial          = 1*15RALPHA
RALPHA       = %x30-39 / %x41-48 / %x4A-4E / %x50-5A ; 0-9 / A-H / J-N / P-Z
RHEX         = %x30-39 / %x41-46 ; 0-9 / A-F
```

The ''icao-mfr-code'' field contains a manufacturer code attributed by the ICAO. There is no public list of the Manufacturer Codes, as far as I've searched.

The ''mfr-serial-len-code'' field is a printable hexadecimal representation of the length of the manufacturer serial number.

The ''mfr-serial'' field contains the device serial number. This field length varies from 1 to 15 bytes.
